name: Browser scroll
description: Scrolls the visible in-app browser viewport or a target scroll container by CSS selector.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 在用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器中滚动视口或目标滚动容器：可按 CSS 选择器定位元素，用 delta 增量滚动或 scrollIntoView 滚入视口。
localizedDescription.en-US: Scrolls the visible in-app browser viewport or a target scroll container. Locate by CSS selector (optional frame:N prefix), then scroll by delta or scrollIntoView.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element or nearest scrollable ancestor. Supports optional frame:N prefix.

deltaX.description: Horizontal scroll delta in CSS pixels.

deltaY.description: Vertical scroll delta in CSS pixels.

block.description: scrollIntoView block alignment: start | center | end | nearest.

inline.description: scrollIntoView inline alignment: start | center | end | nearest.
